text_block_list.text:
"UNBL"... A very big "thank you"... to 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
My arms hold a "supercluster"... Neo 
Universe is "overflowing."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
After my "return," we'll "interact," okay? 
I'll take plenty of "observation images" 
and share them with you, Trainer.
